# WIEZ (weaz.me)

> African fashion social commerce marketplace — discover designs, shop brands, commission custom pieces.

## About

WIEZ is a social commerce platform for fashion and design. Public content includes brand storefronts, product listings, runway designs, and collections.

## Canonical public URLs

- Homepage: https://weaz.me/
- Market feed: https://weaz.me/market
- Brand storefront: https://weaz.me/brand/{username}
- Product: https://weaz.me/p/{product-slug}
- Design: https://weaz.me/designs/{design-id}
- Legal: https://weaz.me/legal

## Crawling policy

- Search indexing policy is controlled via /robots.txt
- Private/authenticated areas (studio, checkout, bag, admin, messages) are not intended for indexing
- Sitemap: https://weaz.me/sitemap.xml

## Contact

- Support: support@wiez.me
